text:
**What this is:** A screenshot of a web app titled **"support-agent console"** in a Chrome browser on an Ubuntu desktop. It shows the troubleshooting console's own input screen, not a sensor, radar, acoustic, camera, launcher or network status display. No sensor data, device status, errors or logs are visible.

**Browser / system**
- URL: `127.0.0.1:8765/#run`
- Two open tabs, both titled "support-agent console". The second tab is active.
- Top bar clock: **Sep 28 17:40**. Keyboard layout indicator: "en".
- Chrome profile badge: "Work".

**Application header**
- Title: **support-agent console**
- Badge outlined in green: `token mode`
- Badge: `claude-opus-5-5`
- Badge: `auth: secrets.local.env`

**Navigation tabs**
- **Run** (selected/highlighted), Approvals, Traces, Knowledge, Agents & permissions, Inventory & systems

**Main panel: "Diagnose"**
- Text input is **empty**. It shows only greyed placeholder text: "e.g. the acoustic sensor shows no tracks"
- Buttons: "Attach" (paperclip icon) and "Send" (highlighted purple/blue)
- Helper text below the input, verbatim: "Runs against recorded fixtures. Live mode stays a deliberate command-line act. Follow-up questions are answered from evidence already gathered — no tools, no device touched."

**Notable / empty**
- No diagnosis has been entered or run.
- There are no results, error messages, warnings, node or host names, or status values on screen.
- The area below the Diagnose panel is blank.
